summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a Securities Purchase Agreement for a private offering of $350M aggregate principal amount of 6.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 to qualified institutional buyers. The filing details customary representations, warranties, and covenants, including a lock-up on equity issuances until 30 days after the effective date and a one-year ban on Variable Rate Transactions, with exceptions for CDIs on ASX, up to $25M strategic investments, and private placements at or above $55.00 per share. This is a standard debt financing to fund GPU and network procurement, not a special situation.
